Step 1 + Lemma A: M in UN => the copower comparison theta_T : T x M1 -> MT, theta_T(t,e)=M(iota_t)(e), is a natural iso, so the underlying functor of M is the writer functor (-) x E, E = M1. Monad structures on (-) x E = monoid structures on E; commutative M iff commutative monoid. Hence UN = {writer monads on commutative monoids}. Uses only copower (T.1) preservation, so independent of the T1 copowers-vs-coproducts gap.

CORROBORATION (own registry, proved): copowers-gap-writer-monad root established, for any closed symmetric monoidal C, that copower-of-unit preservation <=> the induced Set-monad of the copower adjunction is a writer monad (-) x End(I). Step 2: M in CL => (-) tensor empty has a right adjoint [empty,-], and Kl(M)(C tensor empty, B) = Kl(M)(empty,B) = Set(empty,MB) = 1 for all C, so [empty,B] is a TERMINAL object T of Kl(M), forcing MT iso 1. With the writer form (star): T x E iso MT iso 1 => |T||E| = 1 => E iso 1. So M underlying functor iso Id, hence M iso Id as a monad (unique monad structure on Id).
Step 3: Id in CL cap UN. Kl(Id)=Set is cartesian closed (CL); unit 1 connected, Set(1,-)=Id preserves coproducts (UN); by T1 the extension = classical AAG container extension, fully faithful.

Cor 3 (refines the conjecture): no NONTRIVIAL idempotent/localization monad lies in UN. By Lemma A, UN = writer monads; a writer monad is idempotent iff E iso 1 iff Id. Reflectors L = i o R have i (right adjoint) not preserving coproducts. Direct check: terminal monad LX=1 and subsingleton reflection both fail L(1+1) = L1 + L1. So the conjecture's suggested idempotent inhabitants are excluded; TARGET = {Id} exactly.
